## Property description

BULGARIA SOTHEBY'S INTERNATIONAL REALTY presents you a new complex of two buildings, with the possibility of buying luxury apartments located on the first line, right next to the beach itself. The two buildings include a total of 88 apartments and 6 maisonettes for sale, with a beautiful panoramic view of the sea.

The complex has all the necessary amenities for a full vacation. The spacious apartments, with good exposure and distribution, are precisely planned by specialists in the field of architecture and design. The latest world technologies and innovations in construction were used for the construction of the buildings.

PROPERTY FEATURES:

Building 1 has a built-up area of 10,242.15 sq. m. (including terraces), on 12 floors. There are 29 apartments in total, of which 6 are maisonettes. Two of them (M5 and M6) are located on the 1st and 2nd floor. The remaining four maisonettes (M1, M2, M3 and M4) also occupy the 3rd floor, representing a panoramic terrace. All apartments have a sea view.

Building 2 has a built-up area of 15,247.59 sq. m. (including terraces), on 8 floors, in which there are a total of 65 apartments. Directly in front of the building stretches an attractive outdoor swimming pool, surrounded by beautifully decorated green areas. All apartments have a sea view.

Both buildings are designed as an exclusive place for year-round living, executed with exceptional quality of construction materials and exterior design.

The residences are completed with ventilated facades with thermal insulation from mineral wool, and the flat roofs are thermally, steam and hydro insulated, which guarantees their quality and durability. The windows are made with double-glazed units - high-class Schüco aluminum joinery. The residences are equipped with panoramic elevators of the leading world manufacturer Schindler, with 2 in Building 1 and 3 in Building 2.

The luxury staircases and common areas have built-in ventilation, sewage installation, including installation for draining the air conditioning units, fire alarm installation, grounding installation, reliable electrical installation with a high degree of protection. Emergency and evacuation lighting is provided. Heating, ventilation and air conditioning in the buildings is provided by a fully built inverter VRV air conditioning system with DAIKIN cooling and heating, with direct evaporation, with indoor units installed for concealed ceiling installation.

The access control system. The apartments are finished and filled with luxury furniture and are sold ready to live.

Additional services available to the owners of the apartments are a pool with thermal water, a snack bar and restaurants, a gym and opportunities for water sports on the beach - jets, banana, beach volleyball, etc. One parking space is available for each apartment, the price of which is included in the fee for maintenance and management of the complex.

ADVANTAGES OF THE PROPERTY:

• The residences have all the features of modern architecture.

• The buildings have a broken structure, many spacious panoramic terraces and windows, offering beautiful views of the sea for their owners.

• The highest class materials are used for the realization of the project.

• Pool with thermal water

• Snack bar and restaurants,

• Fitness and opportunities for water sports on the beach - jets

Location:

Located in a small quiet bay with eastern exposure, the complex offers excellent conditions for entertainment and relaxation. Only 8 km away. south of Golden Sands, 10 km. from the city of Varna and 16 km. from Varna Airport, the complex combines a good location and a fabulous place to relax.

In its northern part, the complex has a marina offering excellent conditions for 17 yachts. The depth at the quay wall is 1.60m, and the maximum speed is 3 knots. Due to its good position in the bay, the port is naturally protected from winds. This provides an opportunity for year-round residence of your yacht.

Close to the residences, the complex offers great conditions for weddings, business meetings and seminars.

The owners and guests can benefit from the beneficial effects of springs with healing mineral water, luxurious SPA and fitness centers, indoor and outdoor pools, hairdressing and beauty salons located in the complex. In the specialized SPA-centers, highly qualified medical personnel provide care and procedures to improve the health of the owners and guests of the residences. Treatments with healing mud from Lake Varna - medium sulphide, slightly mineralized with an alkaline reaction, trace elements and bioactive substances, will help you enjoy a full and regenerating rest.

In the vicinity, there are wonderful conditions for practicing water sports, beach volleyball, tennis, etc., and for the little ones – attractive children's corners.

Just a few meters from the residences, you can enjoy a varied menu at first-class restaurants and indulge in evening entertainment at the nearby cocktail bars offering refreshing drinks.

Each apartment has the possibility of using one parking space, included in the price of the fee for maintenance and management of the complex.

Choose your new apartment among greenery, peace and comfort!
